findings.observation: Skin value, black hair, round outline, thick brows, brow notch, and broad-cheek identity cues remain recognizable, but the very large round glossy eyes, tiny softened nose and mouth, and smooth juvenile jaw replace the summon’s mature 34-year-old facial geometry with a generic youthful doll face. The healed crooked-nose and adult cheek/jaw planes are no longer strong enough.
The chibi preserves Adia’s clearly muscular shoulder width, solid torso, strong legs, and tall-source posture without adding softness or generic body-fat inflation.
Upper arms, forearms, wrists, open left hand, and empty right fist retain the summon’s strong but plausible relative construction without disproportionate ballooning.
Black long-loose hair retains the same swept part, front wave, side volume, and long gathered mass with no added accent or supernatural treatment.

The moss-ivory short mantle, unarmored tunic, divided lower layers, rolled sleeves, architectural lapel, layered edges, shaped cloth clasp, and wooden comb remain clear. However, only one plain gold ring is visibly retained on the open hand; the required second plain ring is absent from the clenched hand, failing the exact two-ring anchor count.

At original resolution, the top-of-hair-to-chin unit is approximately 351 px against roughly 1175 px standing height, about 29.9%. This is below the frozen 32–36% band and reads closer to a 3.35-head figure than the required 2.75–3.1 heads.
Exactly one subject is present; the complete head and hair, both empty hands, both feet, cape, clothing, comb, and grounding shadow are fully inside generous margins.
The widened grounded stance, offset shoulders, compact silhouette, open hand, and empty fist read clearly as a weaponless ready-idle pose at combat-icon scale.
No weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect is present.
